relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: Injection of the P2X7, NLRP3 and Caspase-1 inhibitors in the muscle prior to induction of the activity-induced muscle pain model, dose-dependently prevented the decrease in MWT ipsilaterally in male mice, but not in female mice

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: blockade of IL-1β before induction prevented muscle hyperalgesia in both male and female mice

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: we propose activation of P2X7 receptors on macrophages located in muscle results in activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome to activate Caspase-1 and release IL-1β to produce pain in male mice

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Blockade of P2X7, NLRP3 or Caspase-1 reduced the increase in IL-1β normally observed with ATP and acidic pH in the macrophages in both male and female macrophages

relationships.subject: Muscle macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: In female mice, depletion of macrophages with clodronate in the muscle, prior to induction of the activity-induced muscle pain model, significantly prevented the decrease in MWT ipsilaterally

key_findings: P2X7, NLRP3 and Caspase-1 blockade prevents or reverses activity-induced muscle hyperalgesia in male but not female mice, early but not at 1 week.
IL-1β blockade and macrophage depletion work in both sexes; P2X7/NLRP3/Caspase-1 inhibitors reduce IL-1β release from LPS-primed macrophages of both sexes.
